# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 8 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 5 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #15151c);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #ffffff);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #15151c;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #15151c | #ffffff | Cards, sheets, post containers, Filament panels. |
| `--surface-raised` | #1e1e28 | #f3f0eb | Hovered rows, inputs, chips, nested cards on surface. |

## Color · Borders and rings

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
```

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--bg, #0b0b0f);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--bg, #faf8f5);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #0b0b0f;
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bg` | #0b0b0f | #faf8f5 | Page background behind everything. Dark is the default theme for the fan app. |
| `--brand` | #e8a33d | #9a5a06 | FanFolio amber. Primary buttons, money (credits, earnings), active nav, links. One brand action per view. |
| `--brand-hover` | #f5b85a | #7e4904 | Hover and pressed state of brand fills. |
| `--focus` | #8ab4ff | #1f5fd1 | 2px focus ring on every interactive element. Blue so it never reads as a brand action. |
| `--success` | #34c47c | #157a47 | Confirmed payments, approved KYC, sent payouts. |
| `--warning` | #f5d06b | #7a5600 | Pending states: 7-day hold, under review, past-due subscription. |
| `--danger` | #f0525b | #c62f3a | Errors, removals, bans, destructive actions. Also the 18+ badge outline. |
| `--overlay` | rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.72) | rgba(22, 20, 26, 0.56) | Scrim behind sheets and dialogs; tint over blurred locked media. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 48px/52px Sora, system-ui, sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display);
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 48px / 52px | 700 | `display` |  |
| `h1` | `.h1`, `--text-h1` | 32px / 40px | 700 | `display` |  |
| `h2` | `.h2`, `--text-h2` | 24px / 32px | 600 | `display` |  |
| `h3` | `.h3`, `--text-h3` | 18px / 26px | 600 | `display` |  |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 15px / 22px | 400 | `sans` |  |
| `small` | `.small`, `--text-small` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `sans` |  |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 12px / 16px | 600 | `sans` |  |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `Sora, system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `Inter, system-ui, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gaps, chip padding. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gaps inside a control group; tight lists. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Card padding on mobile; default gap between blocks. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Card padding on desktop; section gaps. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Page gutters on desktop; gaps between page sections. |

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--radius-sm: 6px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--radius-sm), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius-sm` | 6px | Chips, badges, small inputs. |
| `--radius-md` | 10px | Buttons, inputs, list rows. |
| `--radius-lg` | 16px | Cards, media, bottom sheets. |
| `--radius-pill` | 999px | Balance chip, avatars, filter pills. |
